scope:
HONEST SCOPE: automated static and dynamic checks of this repository. It is NOT a penetration test, a
formal accessibility conformance audit (WCAG/VPAT), or a legal review. `pass` means "this check found no
problem", not "the system is secure/accessible/valid".

items.message: PROJECT_STATE claims a research model/gold dataset only if research-grade artifacts exist
paper results template contains no numbers (all NOT_AVAILABLE)
no research-grade artifacts are bundled (any that exist need provenance verification: the gate is structural)
metric-like documentation passages require source/context review; regex cannot establish fabricated claims

items.message: ADR-009 (source licence) is recorded as PENDING in DECISIONS.md and PROJECT_STATE.json
Tasks 15/16 have preparation tooling; participant evaluation and real paper results remain blocked
demo suggestions carry no probability/confidence and are not labelled as a trained prediction
trainer records pretrained-weights use and fails hard on missing weights
no secrets/tokens committed
logging and text logging are OFF by default
enabled logging stores no learner text by default
learner API rejects unknown fields (visual settings cannot reach classification)
input size limits enforced
research endpoints: token required when set, local-only otherwise
artifact reader blocks traversal and non-artifact paths
front-end loads nothing from external hosts
no innerHTML/eval/document.write in front-end code
browser storage keys include preferences, capability, notes, passages and independent review progress
no wildcard CORS
dependency versions are recorded (requirements-lock.txt)
every page declares a language
every page has a viewport meta tag and title
every statically declared form control has a label
every statically declared button has an accessible name
focus outlines are not removed without a replacement
no animation/transition without a prefers-reduced-motion rule
request code for /api/adapt does not reference visual settings
learner page has an aria-live status region
NOT COVERED: real-browser, mobile, screen-reader and user testing (only jsdom checks exist)
randomness is seeded in every stochastic module
all ML modules import cleanly
baseline predictions are identical across two runs with the same seed
runs record library versions
experiment runner hashes and can verify artifacts
tested dependency versions recorded
run guides for Windows/Colab/product exist
every completed task has a report
required governance/documentation files exist
model card states plainly when no validated model exists
dataset card shows the licence as pending and forbids redistribution
